title: mq-agent.mcp-tool-requirements.v1
description: The MCP tools mq-agent calls, as checked by the stack compatibility gate against each producer's mq-mcp.tool-surface.v1. tests/test_mcp_tool_requirements.py holds it to the code: every literal tool call is declared, and nothing is declared that is no longer called.

max_safety_class.description: Highest ADR-003 class the calling flow is written to accept. A producer class above it blocks the release (MQC020).

arguments.description: Arguments mq-agent sends and relies on. Each must be a producer parameter (MQC021 FAIL).

optional_arguments.description: Sent only after a capability probe such as _tool_supports_input. Absence at the producer is a WARN.

context_arguments.description: Best-effort context the workflow runner adds to every step (repo_path, repo_name). Counted as sent for required parameters, never reported as undeclared.

optional_tool.description: mq-agent handles the tool's absence itself (for example --risk on an older mq-mcp). Absence is a WARN.
